connections.why: Enzymes are proteins whose structure determines their function
Membrane structure controls transport into and out of cells
Glucose and other molecules are oxidised in respiration
Membrane transport underlies neuronal signalling and homeostasis
Gas-exchange surfaces feed the transport systems of animals
Photosynthesis stores the energy respiration later releases
Vaccines and antibodies link to recombinant gene technology
Inheritance of variation drives natural selection
Gene expression and mutation underlie inherited variation
Understanding gene control enables genome manipulation
Biodiversity is a property of the ecosystems studied in Module 6
Photosynthesis fixes the energy flowing through ecosystems
Hormones and signals travel in the transport system
Cell division (meiosis) generates the gametes inheritance depends on
